title: policy.json: flake
description: Flaky tests (design 14.7): how a failing full suite is told apart from a flaky test, how new tests are burned in, and how long a quarantine lasts.

compare_runs.description: How many times the full suite runs on the batch's base, and then on the candidate, to tell a pre-existing flake from an intermittent failure the change introduced. Fails on the base: a pre-existing flake, and nobody is blamed. Fails only on the candidate: the batch is bisected and the culprit goes back to its executor. Fails on neither: inconclusive, nobody is blamed and it is counted. More runs make a comparison clearer and cost suite time. The most that run is compare_runs_max.

compare_runs_max.description: The ceiling on compare_runs, which a controller that raises it for inconclusive comparisons may not pass (design 11.4). The queue never runs more.

burn_in_runs.description: How many times the tests a branch adds or changes run in the fast checks, before the branch joins a batch. One failure sends the branch back. Needs burn_in_command. A branch that changes no file in test_globs is not burned in.

burn_in_command.description: Runs the tests the branch adds or changes, through the shell in the queue's worktree, once per call; the queue calls it burn_in_runs times. HITLD_BURN_IN_FILES holds the changed test files, one path per line. HITLD_BURN_IN_SEED differs on each run, for shuffling the order and varying seeds, and HITLD_BURN_IN_RUN is the run number from 1. A non-zero exit fails the run. With none, new tests are not burned in.
burn_in_command.x-hitld-executes: run through the shell in the merge queue's worktree

test_globs.description: Which files are tests. A branch that adds or changes one is burned in, and a failing test defined in one of them is the branch's to fix, never quarantined while the branch is under test.

environments.description: Labels for this machine's test environment beyond the operating system, such as a database version or a browser, which a quarantine entry's scope may name. The queue's environment is its operating system (linux, darwin or win32) and these labels.

quarantine_days.description: How long a quarantine entry lasts. At expiry the test gates again, and a still-flaky test is a decision for the owner.

fixed_runs.description: How many stress runs under load a fixed flaky test must pass before its fix item is done and its entry is removed.
